{"reason": "Add (high-confidence? edi-change) as a conjunct: v1's FAR is 0.714 (20/28 false) yet six of eight shown false rows have confidence < 0.7 (0.44, 0.60, 0.61, 0.66, 0.67, 0.67). Gating on high-confidence? should cut false arbitrations while keeping recall (1.0) above the 0.8 gate.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
